{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Void Floater''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appeared in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. It is serves as a stronger [[Balloon]] for later waves of these modes. When it loses the [[Shield Health]], the pod that the '''Void Floater''' has with it breaks, causing it to fall down to the ground. This makes it lose the the [[Flying]] attribute, making it vulnerable to towers without flying detection, and also multiplies its speed by 0.675, reducing its speed down to 2.7. ==Logbook Description== "''To take care of a ‘Pod’ is to take care of a child. It needs to be nurtured from start to forever. Vast amounts of Void energy are crammed into these floating pods that are so proudly held overhead by the Void Floater. They are extremely passionate about taking care of it. Once the Pod is destroyed, it will fall to the ground and the Void Floater experiences something like agony, as it is the equivalent of losing their child.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Floater''' has glowing purple skin. It wears a black and purple robe, purple pants, purple belt and black shoes. It had a glowing purple pod overhead which it uses to float above the path. This pod appears to be a purple opaque team beacon from the classic game ''Crossroads''. Once it loses all of its [[Shield Health]], the pod will break, causing it to fall to the ground. ==Strategy== *The '''Void Floater''' is one of the most dangerous enemies in the modes it appears in, with high health, the [[Flying]] attribute, and often appears in large groups. As such, high DPS towers with flying detection like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] are required to deal with it. **Early on, the [[Engineer]] can handle '''Void Floaters''' somewhat consistently, though it is not recommended to completely depend on it. **AOE damage from towers like the [[Tesla]] and [[Mortar]] is recommended against large groups of '''Void Floaters'''. **The [[Firework Technician]] can provide flying detection to nearby towers to help against the '''Void Floater'''. ***Note that the detection duration lasts for a rather short interval. *As the '''Void Floater''' has [[Stun Immunity|Stun Immune]], stun effects from towers such as [[Tesla]] are ineffective against it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|{{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Floater''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidFloaterCA.png|'''Void Floater''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} VoidFloaterIconIG.png|'''Void Floater''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Floater''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Floater''' added. {{Hardcore|[[Void Titan]]|Wave 30|Void Floater|Wave 31|[[Elite Mystery]]|Wave 32}} {{Voidcore|[[Void Reaper]]|Wave 23|Void Floater|Wave 25|[[Void Rusher]]|Wave 27}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
